text:
Maria C: Heads-up — us-west2 GPU pool showing growing backpressure over the last ~6h. Pending requests up ~3x, batch_pack_ratio fell from ~0.9 -> 0.4. Not a full saturation alert but the tail latency is creeping.
Alex P: Confirmed. I see GPU_util stable but queue_length and pending_requests are rising. Looks like batching can't fill because requests are bursty.
Kevin L: Do you have the Prom query for pending_requests? I'm thinking autoscaler hysteresis might be too aggressive on scale-down.
Maria C: Quick queries I ran:
```
# pending requests per pool (5m rate)
sum(rate(pending_requests_total{pool="us-west2-gpu"}[5m])) by (pool)
# batch packing ratio (5m avg)
avg(batch_pack_ratio{pool="us-west2-gpu"}[5m]) by (pool)
# GPU capacity just to compare
sum(gpu_capacity{pool="us-west2-gpu"})
```
Alex P: Also looked at cold starts — scale_up_events spiked around the same time windows. Scale-up is fast but scale-down seems to be pruning too early which kills packing. Might need longer scale-down cooldown or hysteresis on the effective queue metric.
Shanice: Could we make a recording rule that smooths short-term bursts into a single signal for the autoscaler? e.g. a rolling 3m/10m combined signal to avoid reacting to microbursts.
Kevin L: Yes — propose a recording rule like:
```yaml
- record: autoscaler:pending_smoothed:rate
  expr: rate(pending_requests_total[3m]) * 0.6 + rate(pending_requests_total[10m]) * 0.4
```
Then the autoscaler can use that instead of raw pending_requests.
sre-oncall: Agree with smoothing. Also recommend a new dashboard panel that surfaces packable_ratio, batch_pack_ratio, avg_batch_size, and cold_start_rate together by pool/zone so we can correlate.
devops-bot: Deploy pipeline run started: update/recording-rules/2026-03-18 by Kevin L (CI job 4227).
Alex P: For alert tuning: current alert fires at pending_requests > 50 for 5m. Let's change to pending_smoothed > 40 for 10m with a 3-loop debounce in Grafana to avoid noisy paging. Also add annotation for cost impact estimate when alert fires (approx GPU-hours burned for unrecognized burst).
Maria C: Good call. Cost note — these micro-resize thrashes increase unit cost ~15% observed in last incident. We should add an SLA dashboard panel that shows cost-per-1000-requests for each pool so PMs can see economics.
Shanice: I'll add a Grafana panel template and a recording rule PR. Want to also tweak autoscaler: lower target_utilization from 0.75->0.7 and set scale_down_cooldown=600s, scale_up_cooldown=30s to prefer keeping nodes for packing.
Kevin L: Sounds safe. Schedule a canary change in us-west2 only, monitor pack_ratio and 99th tail latency for 30m before rolling.
Maria C: Can someone own the runbook updates? Add steps: check pack_ratio, cold_start_rate, force-scale command, rollback.
Alex P: I'll take runbook + Grafana alerts update. Kevin, ping when your PR is in.
sre-oncall: I'll add an on-call play for "pack-degeneracy" with quick checks and dashboards to jump to.
Maria C: Thanks — keeping this scoped to observability + autoscaler config for now. If the canary looks good we roll to other regions. :thumbsup:
